gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 2486.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: An extension to the existing Dai Kwai Street (G.N. 1002/79 refers) running in a southerly direction for about 195 metres where it terminates as shown coloured green on Drawing No. NTA/TP/R57A. Proposed Name: DAI KWAI STREET. Chinese Version: 大貴街.

No. 2486.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Street commencing at its junction with Dai Kwai Street and running in an easterly direction for about 210 metres where it terminates as shown coloured blue on Drawing No. NTA/TP/R57A. Proposed Name: DAI PANG STREET. Chinese Version: 大鵬街.

history.submitter_remarks: No current LandsD centreline for Dai Pang Street / 大鵬街; events-only until linker finds identity.
